items.summary: Along with the more well-known islands like the Aleutian and Hawaiian Islands, the United States is home to thousands of islands found much closer to the mainland, scattered along coastlines, tucked inside estuaries, and forming barrier islands that separate coastal wetlands from the open ocean .
